description: Price history for one fertilizer product across report periods, from the same twice-monthly USDA MARS production cost reports behind get_fertilizer_price. Use for input-cost trends; use get_fertilizer_price instead when only the latest quote matters. Read-only lookup of stored reports; no API key. Each row carries date, price, unit and source, plus price_low/price_high and change_amount/change_pct when the source report publishes them (null otherwise). Default: up to `periods` most recent reports, oldest first (default 12, max 52). Pass start_date and/or end_date (YYYY-MM-DD) instead to get every stored report inside that inclusive date range, returned as an object with the range actually returned and an observation count. Stored reports reach back to 2024-04-15.

periods.description: Number of most recent report periods to return (default 12, max 52). Ignored when start_date/end_date are given.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive range start (YYYY-MM-DD). With start_date/end_date, returns all stored reports in range instead of the most recent `periods`.

name: get_fertilizer_history
